spec: User reports 'DATABASE_URL environment variable is not set' and subsequent env var errors in Astro/Vite SSR. Root cause: .env at repo root is never loaded into process.env — Astro's Vite module runner looks for .env in apps/web/. Multiple packages read process.env at module top-level (prisma, stripe, auth). Fixes applied: (1) load .env in astro.config.mjs via dotenv.config() with explicit path, (2) make all packages use lazy Proxy init to avoid import-time crashes.
